title: Posnack Jewish Day School — official tuition/admissions
method: Official school page inspected through web extraction or indexed official text
paraphrased_evidence: Grade9–12 tuition includes daily lunch and books. Annual campus/security $1,550 plus returning-student re-enrollment $500. One-time new matriculation $1,250 and application $250 excluded. Device, uniforms and travel extra variable costs.
